Co-SMOS v1.1 — Fix QueueResetManager to work with state.json

CONTEXT:
- Repo: Urania-order/jules
- Backend: smos/core/queue_reset.py, smos/api/main.py
- Problem: POST /api/queue/reset-column always returns moved: 0
- Root cause: QueueResetManager.reset_queue() reads FILES from
  .jules/queue/{pending,running,completed}/*.json, but tasks
  now live in .co-smos/state.json (via QueueManager).
- Evidence:
    ls -la .jules/queue/
      pending/    — empty (.gitkeep only)
      running/    — empty
      completed/  — empty
      deferred/   — 85 files (old tasks)
    curl /api/tasks → 76 tasks (from state.json)
    curl /api/queue/reset-column -d '{"column":"all","confirm":"RESET"}'
      → {"moved": 0, "cleared": {...all 0...}}

GOAL:
Make QueueResetManager work with the SAME source as QueueManager
(state.json / .co-smos/state.json), NOT with .jules/queue/ files.

REQUIREMENTS:

1. REFACTOR smos/core/queue_reset.py
- QueueResetManager must use QueueManager to get tasks
  (same source as /api/tasks)
- Do NOT read .jules/queue/*.json for task discovery
- Do NOT write task files to .jules/queue/*.json

2. RESET LOGIC (state.json based)
- For scope="all": remove ALL tasks from state.json
- For scope="ready": remove tasks with status PENDING/READY
- For scope="running": remove RUNNING
- For scope="review": remove REVIEW
- For scope="blocked": remove BLOCKED
- For scope="completed": remove COMPLETED + FAILED + CANCELLED + DEFERRED
- Archive each removed task to .jules/queue/reset-*.jsonl
  (line per task, with why block)
- Write history to .jules/history/reset-*.md
- Update state.json accordingly

3. RETURN FORMAT
- Keep existing response:
    {status, moved, cleared: {...}, archive, history}

4. KEEP BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY
- If .jules/queue/pending/*.json has files, also process them
  (migration path)
- But primary source is state.json

5. TESTS
- test_reset_all_removes_from_state_json
- test_reset_completed_removes_deferred_and_cancelled
- test_reset_archives_to_jsonl
- test_reset_preserves_why_from_state
- test_reset_updates_state_json
- test_reset_no_files_in_queue_dir
- Update existing tests

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do not touch .co-smos/, .jules/tasks/, .jules/results/, .jules/queue/
  (except archiving to .jules/queue/reset-*.jsonl
   and .jules/history/reset-*.md — allowed)
- Do not weaken existing tests.
- Only operator/admin can reset.
- Preserve WHY from state.json task fields.

TESTS: pytest tests/ + git diff --check
REPORT FORMAT: AGENTS.md §14

FINAL REPORT:
1. what already existed and was reused
2. what was changed (source of truth = state.json)
3. what was deliberately not changed
4. tests/results
5. remaining gaps

AFTER COMPLETION: Suggest 3-5 next steps.

CONTEXT:

GOAL:
Add role-based auth for /api/consult/* and write endpoints.
Three roles: consultant, operator, admin.
External AI consultants (e.g., DeepSeek) MUST be consultant only.

REQUIREMENTS:

1. TOKENS
Read three tokens from environment variables:
- JULES_CONSULTANT_TOKEN  (default: "dev-consultant-token")
- JULES_OPERATOR_TOKEN    (default: "dev-operator-token")
- JULES_ADMIN_TOKEN       (default: "dev-admin-token")

If all three are default, log a warning once at startup.
Do NOT hardcode real secrets in source.

2. ROLE RESOLUTION
- Parse Authorization: Bearer <token>.
- Resolve role by matching token against the three env values.
- Use hmac.compare_digest for all comparisons.
- If no match: 403 CONSULT_AUTH_INVALID.
- If header missing/malformed: 401 CONSULT_AUTH_REQUIRED.

3. ROLE PERMISSIONS
- consultant: GET /api/consult/* only.
- operator:   consultant + POST /api/tasks, PATCH /api/tasks/{id},
              POST /api/proposals, POST /api/proposals/{id}/accept,
              POST /api/batch/run.
- admin:      operator + configuration endpoints (if any).

GET /api/consult/tasks         -> consultant, operator, admin
GET /api/consult/task/{id}     -> consultant, operator, admin
GET /api/consult/events        -> consultant, operator, admin
GET /api/consult/errata        -> consultant, operator, admin

                                  (or public with ?public=1)

PATCH /api/tasks/{id}          -> operator, admin
POST /api/proposals            -> operator, admin
POST /api/proposals/{id}/accept-> operator, admin
POST /api/batch/run            -> operator, admin

5. SAFETY
- consultant MUST NOT be able to POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE anything.
- All write attempts by consultant -> 403 CONSULT_ROLE_FORBIDDEN.
- Anonymous write attempts -> 401 CONSULT_AUTH_REQUIRED.
- Use constant-time compare (hmac.compare_digest).
- Do NOT log token values.
- Do NOT store tokens in localStorage (frontend).

6. ERROR FORMAT
Canonical error responses:
  {status: "error", code: "...", message: "...", exit_code: null}

- git checkout -- . (auto-rollback)
- git clean -fd (auto-delete untracked)
- git push --force-with-lease (auto-rewrite history)

Instead:
- On test failure: keep changes, report, exit 1
- On CI failure: keep commits, suggest git revert, exit 1

GOAL:
Restructure jules-complete.sh to:
1. Run tests BEFORE commit
2. Commit + push ONLY if tests pass
3. Wait for CI AFTER push (max 5 min)
4. Report result — NEVER auto-rollback

REQUIREMENTS:

1. RESTRUCTURE STEPS (7 → 9)
[1/9] stash
[2/9] pull
[3/9] restore
[4/9] post-pull forbidden check
[5/9] update state.json
[6/9] update task record
[7/9] RUN TESTS (NEW)
[8/9] commit + push (only if tests pass)
[9/9] wait for CI (NEW, max 5 min)

2. STEP [7/9] — RUN TESTS (SAFE)
- Run: uv run pytest tests/ -q 2>&1 | tail -10
- If PASSED: continue
- If FAILED:
    echo "❌ Tests FAILED"
    echo "→ Commits NOT created"
    echo "→ Changes preserved in working tree"
    echo "→ To inspect: git status"
    echo "→ To rollback manually: git checkout -- ."
    echo "→ To re-run: ./scripts/jules-complete.sh --task <id>"
    exit 1
- DO NOT auto-rollback
- DO NOT git clean

3. STEP [8/9] — COMMIT + PUSH
- Only if [7/9] passed
- Two commits (code + artifacts) as before
- Push to origin

4. STEP [9/9] — WAIT FOR CI (SAFE)
- After push, poll CI up to 20 times * 15s = 5 min:
    for i in {1..20}; do
      sleep 15
      CI_STATUS=$(gh run list --repo Urania-order/jules --limit 1 \
        --json conclusion --jq '.[0].conclusion')
      if [ "$CI_STATUS" != "null" ] && [ -n "$CI_STATUS" ]; then
        break
      fi
    done
- If "success":
    echo "      ✅ CI passed"
- If "failure":
    echo "      ❌ CI FAILED"
    echo "      → Commits ARE pushed"
    echo "      → To revert: git revert HEAD~2..HEAD && git push"
    echo "      → Or fix and push again"
    exit 1
- If timeout:
    echo "      ⏳ CI timeout"
    echo "      → Check manually: gh run list --repo Urania-order/jules"
    exit 0
- DO NOT auto-force-push

5. ENV VARS
- JULES_SKIP_TESTS=1 → skip [7/9]
- JULES_SKIP_CI=1    → skip [9/9]
- JULES_CI_TIMEOUT=300 → timeout in seconds
- JULES_NO_PUSH=1    → local commit only

6. LOGGING
- Log all steps to .jules/results/post-complete-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.log
- Include: step, status, exit code, timestamp

7. TEST FAILURE REPORT
- Show which tests failed:
    uv run pytest tests/ -q 2>&1 | tail -30
- Show git status
- Show current commit
- Never auto-delete
